description_en: Queries the traffic metrics details for a specified instance
description_zh: 通过指定条件查询指定实例的细分流量指标
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-dashboard-details-flows --instance-id airec-cn-o400whm78004 --start-time 1588521600 --end-time 1588521600 --trace-ids Alibaba --scene-ids test --metric-type USERACTIONUV_COUNT --experiment-ids all --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDashboardDetailsFlows

parameters.description_en:
The metric to query. Valid values:

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_COUNT: The total number of page views (PVs).

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_COUNT: The total number of unique visitors (UVs).

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_RATIO: The traffic conversion rate.

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_RATIO: The traffic per capita.

USER\_PV\_STAY: The dwell time per capita. This metric is for content-based scenarios.

USER\_UV\_STAY: The dwell time per visit. This metric is for content-based scenarios.
parameters.description_zh:
查询指标，枚举选择

USER_ACTION_PV_COUNT 整体流量规模PV

USER_ACTION_UV_COUNT 整体流量规模UV

USER_ACTION_PV_RATIO  流量转化率

USER_ACTION_UV_RATIO 人均流量

USER_PV_STAY 人均停留 （内容型）

USER_UV_STAY 次均停留  （内容型）
